up: Provide the exact activity values (standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units) and compound structures (canonical_smiles) for all compounds tested in the assay with ChEMBL ID CHEMBL4303805. Also include the compound's ChEMBL ID as compound_chembl_id. Do not filter by any other criteria; include all available activity measurements for that assay.
sql: SELECT md.chembl_id AS compound_chembl_id, cs.canonical_smiles, a.standard_type, a.standard_relation, a.standard_value, a.standard_units FROM assays ass INNER JOIN activities a ON ass.assay_id = a.assay_id INNER JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno LEFT JOIN compound_structures cs ON a.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE ass.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL4303805'
